claim_ceiling: This decision admits only the exact immutable Lab Product Capability and business ontology epoch named above for CAV2-D65 construction evaluation. It does not change either candidate status field, release the artifacts publicly, make G-W4 or G-W5 pass by itself, accept the runtime, or authorize publication, deployment, migration, cutover, or external effects.
